verdict.rationale: Ashby documents a custom report builder in-app ('customizable templates, and a report builder to build your own from scratch') and a full REST API with pagination/sync tokens (ashby-docs-9, ashby-docs-8, ashby-docs-10) that lets analysts pull candidate/application/job data programmatically into a warehouse, plus webhooks for real-time event sync (ashby-docs-6, ashby-docs-32). However, there is no explicit mention of native BI connectors (Looker/Tableau/etc.) or a scheduled/automated export feature to a warehouse — analysts would need to build the pipeline themselves using the API/webhooks. Missing for 10: documented BI tool connectors, a native scheduled export/warehouse-sync feature, and independent confirmation that the API/report builder actually supports large-scale analytics extraction.
